caption: The drawing depicts a wooden standing frame with a central vertical pole, supported at the base by three curved legs on a circular platform. The upper part of the frame holds a rectangular panel with rounded corners and decorative scrollwork, bordered in dark brown. The panel features a colorful embroidered or painted pattern with interlacing green vines, blue and yellow flowers, red elements, and light green-blue accented shapes on a beige or cream background. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a small, precise line drawing inset showing a simplified schematic of the same object, indicating height and proportions. The entire composition is set on a lightly textured, off-white background, bordered by a thin red line near the edges of the paper.
title: Petit Point Fire Screen
